title: Massachusetts Town Profiles
scope: This ledger lists all 351 Massachusetts cities and towns by July 1, 2025 Census population (SUMLEV 061), reports five nearest-population peers for Boston, Worcester, Springfield, Cambridge, and Lowell, and also reports ACS 2020-2024 5-year median household income, median home value, poverty rate, bachelor's-or-higher share, median age, and ACS socioeconomic peers (z-scored income, home value, and bachelor's share). Population peers are Census count distance. ACS peers are not the old Pioneer socioeconomic workbook. A DLS levy file is not posted as a stable public CSV. Rankings of change sit on Massachusetts Town Rankings.
exclusions: Does not cover Boston-only payroll (that is Boston City Payroll), statewide multi-metric rankings (Massachusetts Town Rankings), or advice about moving. DLS levy files are not a stable public CSV: decline those.
heritage: Formerly Choose a City or Town, Economic Snapshot, and Find Peers
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from Census sub-est2025_25.csv, SUMLEV 061 (New England county subdivisions), 351 Massachusetts cities and towns. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

q: Population, income, housing, and education for every Massachusetts city and town, with Census and ACS peers.
metric_label: Massachusetts city and town population, July 1, 2025
lead: Massachusetts was 7,154,084 on July 1, 2025 (SRC-625-01). The largest of 351 cities and towns was Boston city at 672,973; the smallest was Gosnold town at 62 (SRC-625-01). Population peers are the five Census 2025 municipalities closest in resident count (SRC-625-02). Boston's nearest peer is Worcester city at 213,862 (derived, SRC-625-02). This is not the old Pioneer socioeconomic peer workbook. A DLS levy file is not posted as a stable public CSV. On the ACS 2020-2024 5-year file, Boston's median household income was $97,344, median home value $731,700, poverty rate 16.6%, and bachelor's-or-higher share 54.9% (SRC-625-03). The nearest ACS socioeconomic peer for Boston is Beverly city (derived, SRC-625-03). That peer set is z-scored ACS income, home value, and bachelor's share, not the old Pioneer workbook. A DLS levy file is not a stable public CSV.
